description: Returns a workout carousel for sample-workout prompts. When the user is connected via OAuth, lists up to 8 team workouts through the Internal API (Bearer token only — no Content API key required). When not connected, returns up to 6 curated guest samples with embedDemoUrl. Use when the user asks for sample workouts, a workout carousel, or embed demo preview. Not for full team-library admin views (use list_team_workouts), integration plans (use get_integration_plan), or copy-paste embed HTML (use get_embed_code_samples).

inputSchema.description: Filters for sample workouts. If both duration_min and duration_max are set, duration_min can't be more than duration_max.

category_id.description: Workout category ID from list_workout_categories. Applies to the team library once signed in; ignored for guest samples.

duration_max.description: Longest workout to include, in minutes, 5 to 120. e.g. 30.

duration_min.description: Shortest workout to include, in minutes, 5 to 120. e.g. 15.

locale.description: Language for names and text, as a locale code, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE" or "de". Omit for the default language.

name: list_sample_workouts
title: List sample workouts
